name: My Beloved Microwave
source:
June Magicia, a witch, has something delivered to her door. A microwave! But it's not the usual microwave, but a talking microwave! It turns out the microwave is a young man named Rich Goldmine who got cursed by June's aunt. Now, June has to undo the curse, but she only has seven days!

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/my-beloved-microwave]itch.io[/url]]
